description: Hourly electricity consumption and PV generation data for a 58-apartment plus-energy building in Utrecht, the Netherlands (2022) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Simone Coccato, Eelke Bontekoe (Utrecht University). Hourly time-series data for the calendar year 2022 from a renovated 58-apartment plus-energy high-rise building in Utrecht, the Netherlands. The dataset contains aggregated electricity consumption and PV generation at two perimeters: (i) whole-building (58 apartments combined with the facilities sub-circuits) and (ii) facilities-only (the building's shared services, including heat pumps, elevators, and common utilities). Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
